project_meta.title: महल के नीचे छिपा सातवाँ दरवाज़ा

global_style.art_style: Light comic-style 2D illustrated medieval kingdom adventure, premium storybook comic aesthetic, expressive character faces, clean confident outlines, rich but soft colors, beautifully detailed royal costumes and palace architecture, cinematic lighting, atmospheric backgrounds, dynamic comic-book framing, varied camera angles, subtle texture, visually engaging compositions, consistent character designs across all scenes.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D render, horror, gore, dark muddy colors, blurry details, flat lifeless compositions, stiff character poses, inconsistent faces, modern objects, modern clothing, text, captions, speech bubbles, watermarks, multiple unrelated moments in one image, montage, future events appearing early.

king_veer.label: King Veer
king_veer.visual_dna: A 42-year-old Indian king with a strong face, neatly trimmed black beard, shoulder-length dark hair, deep brown eyes, golden crown with a central red gemstone, royal maroon and gold embroidered robes, broad shoulders, commanding but thoughtful expression.

queen_tara.label: Queen Tara
queen_tara.visual_dna: A 35-year-old Indian queen with expressive almond-shaped eyes, long black hair in a traditional braid, elegant emerald-green and gold royal saree, delicate golden jewelry, small emerald forehead ornament, intelligent and observant expression.

minister_rudra.label: Minister Rudra
minister_rudra.visual_dna: A 55-year-old royal minister, narrow calculating eyes, thin grey moustache, slicked-back grey hair, dark navy royal robes with silver embroidery, a large signet ring, polite smile that hides a suspicious personality.

captain_arya.label: Captain Arya
captain_arya.visual_dna: A 30-year-old female palace guard captain, athletic build, focused eyes, dark hair tied in a tight bun, bronze and navy armor, red shoulder sash, sword at her waist.

royal_palace.label: Royal Palace
royal_palace.visual_dna: A magnificent medieval Indian palace with sandstone walls, carved pillars, arched corridors, colorful glass windows, grand courtyards, royal banners, golden lamps and intricate stone flooring.

royal_throne_room.label: Throne Room
royal_throne_room.visual_dna: A grand throne room with a raised golden throne, maroon carpet, tall carved pillars, huge arched windows, royal banners and warm sunlight falling across polished stone floors.

hidden_cellar.label: Hidden Cellar
hidden_cellar.visual_dna: A secret underground stone chamber beneath the palace, narrow arched passages, dusty walls, wooden grain crates, oil lamps, old iron shelves and a concealed stone entrance.

royal_kitchen.label: Royal Kitchen
royal_kitchen.visual_dna: A large medieval palace kitchen with copper pots, clay ovens, wooden tables, sacks of grain, hanging herbs and servants moving through warm firelight.

secret_door.label: Secret Stone Door
secret_door.visual_dna: A cleverly hidden stone door built into an old palace wall, with a small carved lotus symbol and a concealed iron lever.

royal_seal.label: Royal Seal
royal_seal.visual_dna: A heavy gold royal signet seal bearing the symbol of a roaring lion, with a polished wooden handle.

grain_crates.label: Hidden Grain Crates
grain_crates.visual_dna: Rows of large wooden crates and tied burlap sacks filled with wheat and rice, stacked inside a secret underground chamber.

folded_note.label: Mysterious Note
folded_note.visual_dna: A small folded piece of yellowed parchment with a rough handwritten warning in dark ink, tied with a thin red thread.

beats.narration_text: राजा वीर के राज्य में सब कुछ खुशहाल था।
beats.prompt_action: Show the magnificent kingdom at sunrise, busy market streets, colorful rooftops and distant palace towers. {assets.royal_palace} Establish a peaceful prosperous kingdom.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Warm morning light spreads across the kingdom.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन महल में एक अजीब बात होने लगी।
beats.prompt_action: Show one tall palace window glowing strangely in the early morning while the surrounding palace corridor remains quiet. Focus on the unusual window.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A faint shadow is visible behind the window.

beats.narration_text: हर रात रसोई से अनाज गायब हो जाता।
beats.prompt_action: Show a nearly empty wooden grain bin inside {assets.royal_kitchen}, with only a little wheat remaining at the bottom.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A few scattered grains lie on the wooden floor.

beats.narration_text: पहले सबने इसे छोटी चोरी समझा।
beats.prompt_action: Show two worried palace kitchen servants inspecting an open grain sack, exchanging confused looks.
beats.session_delta_prompt: One servant points toward the missing grain.

beats.narration_text: फिर एक रात रानी तारा को एक पर्ची मिली।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.folded_note} resting on Queen Tara's bedside table beside a small golden lamp. Only the mysterious note and table are in focus.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The red thread around the note is clearly visible.

beats.narration_text: उस पर लिखा था, महल के नीचे देखिए।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Tara holding the unfolded parchment and reading its short warning, her eyes narrowing with curiosity. {assets.queen_tara}
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her fingers grip the edge of the parchment.

beats.narration_text: तारा ने तुरंत राजा को बुलाया।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Tara walking quickly through a carved palace corridor toward the king's chamber, holding the folded note.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her emerald saree moves as she walks with urgency.

beats.narration_text: राजा ने पर्ची पढ़ी और चौंक गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.king_veer} holding the note, eyebrows raised and face suddenly serious, with Queen Tara standing beside him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The king looks from the note toward the queen.

beats.narration_text: दोनों ने रात में रसोई की निगरानी करने का फैसला किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer and Queen Tara quietly planning beside a palace window, with the mysterious note on a small table between them.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Both look determined and speak in hushed voices.

beats.narration_text: आधी रात को वे रसोई के पास छिप गए।
beats.prompt_action: Show the king and queen hiding behind a stone pillar near the closed royal kitchen entrance, with a dim oil lamp nearby.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The palace corridor is quiet and almost empty.

beats.narration_text: तभी एक साया धीरे-धीरे अंदर आया।
beats.camera_type: POV shot from behind the pillar
beats.prompt_action: Show a mysterious cloaked figure entering the royal kitchen through its half-open wooden door, seen from the hiding place of the king and queen.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The figure moves carefully without looking back.

beats.narration_text: उसके हाथ में महल की चाबी थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show the mysterious figure's gloved hand holding an old iron palace key, illuminated by a small oil lamp.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The key catches a brief glint of light.

beats.narration_text: उसने अनाज की बोरी उठाई।
beats.prompt_action: Show the cloaked figure lifting a heavy burlap sack of grain from the kitchen floor.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The figure struggles slightly under the weight.

beats.narration_text: और दीवार की तरफ बढ़ने लगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show the cloaked figure carrying the grain sack toward an old stone wall at the far end of the kitchen.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The figure approaches a wall with a carved lotus pattern.

beats.narration_text: उसने कमल के निशान को दबाया।
beats.prompt_action: Show a gloved finger pressing the small carved lotus symbol on the stone wall. {assets.secret_door}
beats.session_delta_prompt: Fine dust falls from the carved stone.

beats.narration_text: और दीवार का एक हिस्सा खुल गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show the concealed stone door sliding open inside the royal kitchen, revealing a narrow dark passage behind it. {assets.secret_door}
beats.session_delta_prompt: A thin line of warm light appears inside the passage.

beats.narration_text: राजा और रानी ने एक-दूसरे को देखा।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer and Queen Tara peeking from behind the pillar, exchanging a shocked and suspicious glance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The queen raises one finger to signal silence.

beats.narration_text: वे चुपचाप उस गुप्त रास्ते में घुस गए।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer and Queen Tara carefully entering the narrow stone passage one behind the other, leaving the kitchen behind.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Their silhouettes are lit by a faint distant glow.

beats.narration_text: रास्ता महल के नीचे बहुत दूर तक जाता था।
beats.prompt_action: Show a long underground stone corridor with repeating arches, old wall lamps and a distant bend disappearing into darkness.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The passage feels much larger than expected.

beats.narration_text: आगे उन्हें पैरों के ताज़ा निशान दिखे।
beats.prompt_action: Show fresh muddy footprints across the dusty stone floor of the underground passage.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The footprints lead deeper into the corridor.

beats.narration_text: रानी ने राजा को रुकने का इशारा किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Tara gently stopping King Veer with her raised hand, both listening carefully in the underground passage.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The king freezes and looks toward the passage ahead.

beats.narration_text: उन्हें आगे किसी के बात करने की आवाज़ आई।
beats.prompt_action: Show the distant end of the underground corridor with a faint glow spilling from a partially open stone doorway.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A vague human silhouette appears near the doorway.

beats.narration_text: राजा ने धीरे से दरवाज़े के पास झाँका।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer cautiously peeking around the edge of the stone doorway, one eye visible as he looks inside.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His expression changes from caution to disbelief.

beats.narration_text: अंदर अनाज के सैकड़ों बोरे रखे थे।
beats.prompt_action: Reveal a huge underground chamber packed with towering stacks of grain sacks and wooden crates. {assets.grain_crates} The chamber is lit by oil lamps.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The scale of the hidden storage becomes clear.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन वहाँ चोर नहीं, मंत्री रुद्र खड़ा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.minister_rudra} standing beside the stacked grain sacks, holding a small ledger and inspecting the supplies.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The minister turns slightly toward someone outside the frame.

beats.narration_text: रुद्र किसी अजनबी से कह रहा था, योजना तैयार है।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra speaking quietly to a shadowed stranger inside the cellar, one hand resting on a wooden crate.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Rudra gestures toward a rolled map on the table.

beats.narration_text: कल सुबह पूरा राज्य भूख से परेशान होगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra with a cold calculating smile as he speaks, the underground grain stacks blurred behind him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His expression becomes more confident.

beats.narration_text: रानी समझ गई कि अनाज जानबूझकर छिपाया गया था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Tara watching from behind the doorway, her eyes focused and expression suddenly firm.
beats.session_delta_prompt: She glances toward the hidden grain stacks.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन रुद्र की असली चाल अभी बाकी थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show a rolled royal decree lying on a wooden table beside the minister's ledger and a bottle of black ink.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The royal seal on the decree is visible.

beats.narration_text: वह राजा के नाम से नकली आदेश लिख रहा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra's hand writing a royal order on parchment with a feather quill, beside the golden lion seal.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The fresh ink glistens on the parchment.

beats.narration_text: उसमें लिखा था कि पड़ोसी राज्य ने अनाज चुराया है।
beats.prompt_action: Show the minister examining a forged royal decree with a map of two neighboring kingdoms spread beside it.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His finger rests on the border between the kingdoms.

beats.narration_text: वह दोनों राज्यों के बीच युद्ध करवाना चाहता था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra pointing at the border on the map, wearing a satisfied and ambitious expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The candlelight casts a sharp shadow across the map.

beats.narration_text: तभी रानी के पैर से एक पत्थर खिसक गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Tara's sandal accidentally pushing a loose stone across the underground floor.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The small stone rolls away from her foot.

beats.narration_text: आवाज़ सुनकर रुद्र पीछे मुड़ा।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra suddenly turning his head toward the doorway, eyes widened with suspicion.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His hand pauses above the forged decree.

beats.narration_text: राजा और रानी की पहचान सामने आ गई।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer and Queen Tara stepping out from behind the stone doorway into the cellar, facing Minister Rudra.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The minister stands frozen beside the table.

beats.narration_text: रुद्र ने तुरंत पास की रस्सी खींच दी।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra urgently pulling a thick rope hanging beside the cellar wall.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The rope becomes taut in his hand.

beats.narration_text: ऊपर महल में खतरे की घंटी बज उठी।
beats.prompt_action: Show a large bronze alarm bell swinging violently in a palace tower, its rope pulled tight.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The bell is caught mid-swing.

beats.narration_text: कुछ ही पल में सैनिक तहखाने में पहुँच गए।
beats.prompt_action: Show Captain Arya leading palace guards down the underground stone stairs with torches and drawn swords.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The guards hurry toward the cellar entrance.

beats.narration_text: रुद्र ने भागने की कोशिश की।
beats.prompt_action: Show Minister Rudra rushing toward a narrow side passage, his navy robe swinging behind him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His expression shows panic.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन कप्तान आर्या ने उसका रास्ता रोक लिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show Captain Arya standing firmly in the minister's path, holding her sword across the passage.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Rudra stops abruptly in front of her.

beats.narration_text: उसके हाथ से नकली आदेश नीचे गिर गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show the forged royal decree falling from the minister's hand onto the stone floor.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The parchment lands open with the royal seal visible.

beats.narration_text: राजा ने उसे राजद्रोह के आरोप में गिरफ्तार करवा दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show two palace guards restraining Minister Rudra while King Veer stands before him with a stern expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Rudra lowers his head as the guards secure his wrists.

beats.narration_text: अगली सुबह छिपा हुआ अनाज जनता में बाँट दिया गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show palace workers distributing grain sacks to grateful families in the kingdom's public square.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Villagers receive the supplies with relieved expressions.

beats.narration_text: राज्य में फिर से खुशहाली लौट आई।
beats.prompt_action: Show the lively kingdom market filled with villagers, merchants and colorful stalls under bright morning sunlight.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The streets feel peaceful and lively again.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन राजा को तहखाने में एक और चीज़ मिली थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer standing alone in the underground chamber, holding a small old metal key and studying it with a puzzled expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His eyes move toward the key's unusual markings.

beats.narration_text: उस चाबी पर रानी के परिवार का निशान बना था।
beats.prompt_action: Show the old metal key resting in the king's palm, revealing a tiny engraved symbol matching Queen Tara's family crest.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The mysterious family symbol is sharply visible.

beats.narration_text: तो क्या रानी इस रहस्य के बारे में पहले से जानती थी?
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Tara standing in the palace corridor, looking directly toward the viewer with a calm but unreadable expression, one hand resting near her family pendant.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A faint mysterious smile appears on her face.

beats.narration_text: आपको क्या लगता है, रानी का उस गुप्त दरवाज़े से क्या रिश्ता था?
beats.prompt_action: Show the old engraved key in the foreground and Queen Tara standing in soft focus behind it inside the palace corridor, leaving the connection mysterious.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Hold on the key and the queen's mysterious expression.
